description_en: Asynchronously retrieves the list of outbound call task groups. When the Async parameter is specified in the ListJobGroup operation, use this operation to retrieve the results of the asynchronous ListJobGroup call
description_zh: 异步获取外呼任务组列表。当在调用ListJobGroup接口时指定了Async时，使用此接口获取异步ListJobGroup的结果
name: ListJobGroupsAsync

parameters.help_en: The value of AsyncTaskId returned by ListJobGroup when the Async mode is used. You can use this ID to retrieve the results of the asynchronous query
parameters.help_zh: 当调用ListJobGroup时采用Async模式时，ListJobGroup返回的AsyncTaskId的值。根据该ID可以获取异步查询的结果
parameters.name: async_task_id
